title: D’RespNeT: A UAV Dataset and YOLOv8-DRN Model for Aerial Instance Segmentation of Building Access Points for Post-Earthquake Search-and-Rescue Missions
reasoning: The paper describes the creation and evaluation of a computer vision dataset for search-and-rescue operations. It focuses on the technical aspects of instance segmentation for drones and does not involve any benchmarking or evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics.
